deadline.value: Fall applications are due January 1; later ones are reviewed only at the department's discretion.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall admission is January 1 of the year for which you are applying for admission

app_fee.value: The department charges no application fee.
app_fee.quote: There is no fee to apply for admission to our graduate programs.

fee_waiver.value: No fee is charged, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no fee to apply for admission to our graduate programs.

gre_general.value: The department does not require the general GRE for admission.
gre_general.quote: does not require the general GRE or the physics GRE for admission consideration

gre_subject.value: The physics GRE is not required either.
gre_subject.quote: does not require the general GRE or the physics GRE for admission consideration

toefl_min.value: The department's TOEFL iBT minimum is 80.

ielts_min.value: The department's IELTS minimum is 6.5 overall.

supervisor.value: No advisor needs to be chosen before applying; admission is decided by the department's Graduate Admissions Committee.
supervisor.quote: No, you do not need to select a research advisor prior to applying for admission.

also.quote: All admission decisions are made by the department's Graduate Admissions Committee, not individual faculty members.

funding.value: Teaching assistantships with a tuition waiver and stipend are not guaranteed; they depend on available funding and positions.
funding.quote: While a TA is not guaranteed, we strive to offer a TA to each student selected for admission.

also.quote: Applications receive full consideration for assistantship and fellowship opportunities.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the minimum to apply; students who finish a master's in the department must reapply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: You must have a minimum of a bachelor's degree

also.quote: Students who pass their master's defense and intend to pursue a Ph.D. must reapply to the Ph.D. program.

notes: Department states its own TOEFL 80 and IELTS 6.5 minimums. The deadline page gives 'January 1' with no year, so 2027-01-01 is inferred. Astronomy and Astrophysics is listed only as a research area, so no astronomy record. Medical Biophysics (mbio.html) is a separate PhD run by this department and has no field slot in this file.
